name: no-comments
description: Write code with ZERO comments, ever. Never write a code comment of any kind in any language — no `//`, `/* */`, doc comments, docstrings, `#`, `--`, `<!-- -->`, no TODO/Note/FIXME, no commented-out code. The code carries all meaning itself: better names, smaller functions, explicit types, enums, and well-named constants replace every comment. Machine-read directives (shebangs, linter/pragma directives, required license headers) are the only allowed comment-syntax lines. Always-on via hooks — enforces the zero-comment rule as a persistent default, not just when invoked.
